_meta.purpose: Operator + tier dataset for a neutral crypto-casino comparison engine. Input: user wager band. Output: ranked recommendations.
critical_notes: Rakeback headline rates are not comparable like-for-like. Normalise to effective cash value before scoring.
Where a competitor does not publish tier thresholds, use null/undisclosed and score transparency accordingly.
Some figures are verified from source documents or official pages; unpublished formulas remain directional and should be labelled as such.

operators.name: XTP
operators.positioning: Cash-first cashback program with low entry friction and tier-transfer mechanics.
operators.tier_match_terms: Tier Transfer maps proof of external status to an XTP tier plus sized reload.
operators.settlement: Ongoing cashback credited via cashback mailer/reminder.
operators.offer_summary: 20% ongoing cash cashback, credited via cashback mailer/reminder. Welcome choice can add 12% rakeback for 14 days, 1,000 free spins on a $200 deposit, or a 100% deposit match up to $1,000 in the first 14 days.
operators.reset_behaviour: Lifetime weighted XP never decreases; top two tiers need trailing activity to hold.
operators.vip_host_entry: Host chat at Silver; dedicated host at Gold.
operators.watch_out: Confirm your selected welcome choice and playthrough before claiming; cashback eligibility and timing can vary by account and campaign.

operators.name: Stake
operators.licence: Curacao and local licensed brands in some markets
operators.positioning: Market leader; casino and sportsbook at massive scale.
operators.settlement: Weekly and monthly rewards tied to recent volume.
operators.offer_summary: Around 5% rakeback from Bronze, with weekly and monthly bonuses at higher tiers. Higher-tier rates and thresholds are not fully published.
operators.reset_behaviour: Tiers held; upper-tier reloads tied to recent activity.
operators.watch_out: Scale means low-tier players get a less personal experience; thresholds above Bronze are not published.

operators.name: Rollbit
operators.positioning: GambleFi: casino, sportsbook and leveraged crypto futures.
operators.offer_summary: Multiplier-based rakeback linked to RLB/Rollbot mechanics, with token/NFT upside but less clean cash value.
operators.reset_behaviour: Rakeback multipliers tied to RLB and Rollbot holdings.
operators.watch_out: Rewards are entangled with RLB token price; volatility can erode realised value.

operators.name: Roobet
operators.positioning: Established crypto casino and sportsbook with a deep no-reset ladder.
operators.settlement: Instant, daily, weekly, monthly, plus Vault claims.
operators.offer_summary: Instant rakeback every 30 minutes, daily/weekly/monthly reward cadence, and Vault claims. Exact rates are not publicly disclosed.
operators.vip_host_entry: Invite-only VIP club; personal manager at upper tiers.
operators.watch_out: Some long-term high-rollers report benefits being trimmed; thresholds not published.

operators.name: BC.Game
operators.settlement: Ongoing by level, paid in BCD.
operators.offer_summary: Advertised 20-24% rakeback paid in BCD token, plus weekly/monthly token bonuses. Discount versus clean cash for comparison.
operators.watch_out: Headline rate is high but paid in BCD; discount versus pure cash and account for withdrawal complaints.

operators.name: Thrill
operators.positioning: Rakeback-first challenger with the highest advertised rates.
operators.tier_match_terms: Import VIP status with proof of prior status.
operators.offer_summary: Advertises up to 70% rakeback and up to 10% weekly lossback, but the rakeback formula is opaque and should not be taken at face value.
operators.watch_out: Headline 70% is not normalised; formula is opaque and responsible-gambling tooling is reported thin.

operators.name: Yeet
operators.positioning: VC-backed challenger with a deep, low-friction ladder.
operators.tier_match_terms: VIP Tier Match imports status from a rival casino.
operators.offer_summary: Instant rakeback from the first tier, $100 wagered entry, weekly/monthly bonuses, and VIP Tier Match for players switching from rivals.
operators.vip_host_entry: From Diamond; concierge at top tiers.
operators.watch_out: Token or airdrop value is unproven; very low entry dilutes status signal.

operators.name: Duel
operators.positioning: Zero-edge / 100% RTP challenger for selected in-house games.
operators.settlement: Value comes from zero house edge / 100% RTP on eligible Duel games rather than a traditional rebate.
operators.offer_summary: Duel advertises zero house edge on selected games, effectively 100% RTP where eligible. This is not normal rakeback and does not apply to every casino game.
operators.reset_behaviour: No traditional tier reset; value depends on playing eligible zero-edge games.
operators.watch_out: 100% RTP applies to selected Duel games, not necessarily slots, live casino, sportsbook, or third-party content. Verify game eligibility before treating it as equivalent to rakeback.
source_terms: When the house edge is zero

operators.name: Dicey
operators.positioning: Magic Eden-backed beta with tight reward loops.
operators.offer_summary: Rakeback on house edge claimable every 15 minutes, daily bonus, and +15% Rakeboost for 60 minutes after claiming.
operators.watch_out: Still in beta; responsible-gambling tooling minimal and unproven at scale.

operators.name: 21.com
operators.positioning: Large four-deposit welcome package backed by an instant-rakeback VIP club.
operators.settlement: Instant rakeback, with weekly and monthly rewards shown in the Rewards Hub.
operators.offer_summary: Up to $7,000 in matched bonuses plus 130 free spins across the first four deposits, alongside an Elite Club advertising instant rakeback and VIP-host support.
operators.reset_behaviour: VIP points and downgrade rules are not clearly published on the public page.
operators.vip_host_entry: VIP Host advertised for Elite Club members; entry level not disclosed.
operators.watch_out: The welcome bonus carries 35x bonus wagering within 7 days and a 10x maximum-return cap. South Africa, the US, UK and several other markets are blocked.

operators.name: Shuffle
operators.positioning: Stake-style challenger with a published instant-rakeback formula and a deep 13-tier lifetime ladder.
operators.tier_match_terms: Informal rank match up to Platinum via live support with proof of external VIP status; transfer voids Level Up promo eligibility. Not in published T&Cs.
operators.settlement: Instant rakeback per bet; daily bonus from Bronze; weekly (Thursday) and monthly bonuses from Silver (10,000 XP).
operators.offer_summary: Published 5% of house edge instant cash rakeback (casino only, not sports), plus daily/weekly/monthly bonuses whose formulas are proprietary. 50+ levels across 13 tiers with fully published XP thresholds; lifetime XP never resets.
operators.reset_behaviour: Lifetime cumulative XP, never resets. VIP host at Sapphire+.
operators.watch_out: Instant rakeback is 5% OF the edge (~0.05-0.25% of wager) — easily confused with wager-basis headlines. Weekly/monthly bonus math is a black box. Casino Guru Safety Index 4.8 (Low) with a heavy pattern of withdrawals stuck 'under review' and KYC demands at cashout; Trustpilot score currently withheld. Welcome bonuses are code-dependent with 35-40x wagering and 10% max-bet rule.

operators.name: Gamdom
operators.positioning: 2016-era incumbent with three-layer cash rakeback and an explicitly undisclosed, personalised formula.
operators.settlement: Instant (claimable multiple times daily), weekly, and monthly buckets; manual claim but rewards never expire.
operators.offer_summary: Three-layer cash rakeback (instant/weekly/monthly) across the 24-level, 8-tier Royalty Up ladder. Official help center states the formula is not publicly shared and rewards are personalised. New accounts get 15% boosted instant rakeback for 7 days if activated within 6 hours of registration.
operators.reset_behaviour: Royalty Up ranks have no published reset; invite-only VIP Club above it requires ongoing activity to maintain.
operators.vip_host_entry: Invite-only VIP Club; dedicated team, fee-free withdrawals.
operators.watch_out: Affiliate 'up to 60%' claims are not official — rates, thresholds, and formula are all explicitly undisclosed and dynamic. The 6-hour activation window on the new-account boost is easy to miss. Strong aggregate trust (Casino Guru 9.8) but documented KYC escalation and multi-week holds after big wins.

operators.name: Duelbits
operators.positioning: Highest published like-for-like cash rakeback in the dataset, with a worked formula and official VIP transfer route.
operators.tier_match_terms: Official VIP Transfer Programme via transfers@duelbits.com; terms unpublished, case-by-case.
operators.settlement: Four claim buckets: instant (10%) + daily (5%) + weekly (5%) + monthly (5%) of house edge, plus level-up milestone bonuses of 5-12.5%.
operators.offer_summary: Published 25% combined house-edge rakeback (formula with worked example on official blog), cash with no wagering, accruing from the first bet. 31 levels plus a Bronze/Silver/Gold VIP Club overlay; unclaimed level bonuses roll forward with no expiry. Official ceiling claim is 47.5% with milestones.
operators.reset_behaviour: Lifetime wagering progression, no reset; unclaimed milestone bonuses roll into later milestones.
operators.vip_host_entry: Dedicated VIP manager from VIP Club Silver.
operators.watch_out: Third-party 'up to 50%' is affiliate inflation — official copy tops out at 47.5% and is internally inconsistent. Per-level thresholds and VIP Club entry criteria are unpublished. Welcome free-spin stages expire 24h after crediting. Heavy KYC reported after large wins (one disputed $253k case).

operators.name: Cloudbet
operators.positioning: 2013-era original crypto sportsbook with fully published tier thresholds and rate tables.
operators.settlement: On collection, half instant to wallet, half to a Rewards Calendar unlocking 3x daily with 12-hour claim windows (unclaimed forfeits); plus daily/weekly/monthly cash drops.
operators.offer_summary: Published rate tables: 5% of house edge base (Bronze-Ruby), 10% at Diamond+, with temporary TURBO boosts up to 25% at Blue Diamond ($1B+ lifetime turnover). 8 tiers with fully published lifetime-turnover thresholds; tier is permanent. Casino bets only — sports earn weekly cash drops instead. $2,500 no-rollover welcome package over 30 days.
operators.reset_behaviour: Tier permanent, lifetime turnover never resets.
operators.vip_host_entry: VIP hosts at upper tiers; Blue Diamond invitation-only.
operators.watch_out: Headline 25% requires Blue Diamond plus an active 20-90 minute TURBO — realistic base is 5% for the first six tiers. 12-hour claim windows forfeit unclaimed rewards. Regular rakeback only starts after the 30-day welcome flow completes. Reports of accounts frozen for 'betting integrity review' after large wins.

operators.name: Metaspins
operators.positioning: 1,000+ level grind ladder with per-level rakeback and a double-or-nothing coin-flip mechanic.
operators.tier_match_terms: Review-claimed: screenshot of external VIP status, 2-week gameplay monitoring before match and host assignment. Not on official pages.
operators.settlement: Claimable at each level-up; stacked rakeback expires after 7 days. Weekly wager-free cashback and monthly reloads via VIP Club.
operators.offer_summary: Published per-level rates from 3% (Level 1) to 15% (Level 1000+), but the basis is not officially defined (reviews say house edge). $1 wagered = 1 VIP point, all games equal. Each claim can be gambled on a coin flip up to 8x — a losing flip forfeits everything. Status never resets, though perks pause after 2 months inactive.
operators.reset_behaviour: Levels retained indefinitely; perks suspended after 2 months of inactivity until ~$10k re-wagered (review claim).
operators.vip_host_entry: VIP host via VIP Club tiers (Earthling through Mysterium).
operators.watch_out: The 'up to 120%' headline requires level 1000+ AND three consecutive coin-flip wins (12.5% chance); a single loss wipes the accumulated rebate. 7-day rakeback expiry. Welcome bonus is 40x wagering in 7 days. Trustpilot ~2.0 with confiscation complaints ($29k, $9k) despite Casino Guru 8.5 — fast small withdrawals, friction on large ones.
